name: Hyperconsciousness
summary: Developer-alpha Rust MCP server for encrypted, append-only knowledge with scoped, expiring agent access.
description: Stores signed records and syncs them across devices. Provides keyword search and record retrieval through a local MCP server. Grants limit returned data but do not sandbox processes; hosted model providers can see returned plaintext. No independent security audit is claimed.

agent_access.notes: Build from source with Rust 1.88.0 and cargo build --release --locked, following the README for native prerequisites. Initialize an isolated store and create a scoped grant, then configure the absolute hc executable with args ["mcp", "--as", "<grant-id>", "--dir", "/absolute/path/to/store"]. Writes require --write plus the appropriate grant.
